title: Architecture Meta Sidecar
description: Phase 6 → Phase 7 handoff sidecar. Sidecar to `_context/sacred/architecture.md`; lives at `_context/sacred/architecture.meta.json`. Consumed by Phase 7 Breakdown for component-by-component story decomposition.

version.description: Architecture document version (matches frontmatter `version` of architecture.md).

nfr_axes_addressed.description: List of NFR axes from PRD that have architectural strategy. Should match PRD nfr_axes.

resolves_design_delta_or_null.description: If non-null: this ADR is a REQUIRED ADR resolving a Phase 5 flagged delta (silent-divergence guard). If null: organic ADR.

brownfield_modules_handled.description: Count of Phase 4 legacy-migration-plan modules that the architecture incorporates per their decisions (keep/refactor/scaffold/reference).

flagged_deltas_resolved.description: Count of Phase 5 flagged_for_architecture_ADR deltas that have corresponding ADRs. MUST equal len(`phase-5-to-6 handoff.architecture_adrs_required[]`) — verified by Phase 6 gate check #5 (silent-divergence guard).

architecture_deltas_surfaced.description: Count of Phase 6 architecture-deltas (PRD/UX gaps surfaced at architecture time). Forward-carry mechanism — see Phase 6 deep-dive §12.
